samples.excerpt:
Andrianna Tamara Campbell-LaFleur ( née Campbell ) bụ onye nkatọ nka America, onye na-ahụ maka ihe na onye ọkụkọ ihe mere eme bụ ihe na nka America nke ike apụ nke ndụ na nke iri abụọ.


== Ndụ mmalite na agụmakwụkwọ ==
Campbell-LaFleur akwụkwọ akwụkwọ na Rhode Island School of Design (RISD), ebe ọ akara nzere BFA ya na akwụkwọ akwụkwọ na 2001. [1] Mgbe ọ nọ na RISD, RISD Museum nyere ya nri Carnegie Fellowship .  Ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka onye na-arụkọ ọrụ na Forbes, bụ ebe o jikwaa nchịkọta ihe osise mba ụwa.

samples.excerpt:
Blanca de Castejón (Mee 13, 1906 - Disemba 26, 1969) bụ onye na-eme ihe nkiri na Puerto Rican nke rụrụ ọrụ na Golden Age nke sinima Argentina n'ime 1930 na karịsịa Golden Age nke sinima Mexico kemgbe ime 1940, ebe ihe gaara ya nke ọma na nweta nkwanye ùgwù nke ukwuu. A mụrụ ya na Comerío, Puerto Rico, ma nwụọ na Mexico City.

samples.title: Drexel University
samples.excerpt: Drexel University bụ mahadum nyocha nkeonwe nke nwere nnukwu ogige ya dị na Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA. Anthony J. Drexel, onye na-ahụ maka ego na onye na-eme ebere, hiwere ya na 1891. E hiwere ya na mbụ dị ka Drexel Institute of Art, Science and Industry, aha ya bụ Drexel Institute of Technology na 1936 tupu o jiri aha ya ugbu a na 1970. Ruo 2020, ihe karịrị ụmụ akwụkwọ 24,000 debanyere aha na ihe karịrị mmemme mahadum 70 na ihe karịrị mmemme masters, doctoral, na ọkachamara 100 na mahadum ahụ. A maara Mahadum Drexel maka mmemme agụmakwụkwọ mmekorita ya (co-op).

samples.title: Ihe mkpofu efu
samples.excerpt: Ihe mkpofu efu bụ usoro ụkpụrụ ndị lekwasịrị anya na mgbochi mkpofu nke na-agba ume imezigharị usoro ndụ ihe onwunwe ka e wee jiri ngwaahịa niile e kwesiri ikpofu ekpofu mee ihe (ya bụ, na-eji ya eme ihe) na / ma ọ bụ jiri ya mee ihe ọzọ. Ebumnuche nke mmegharị ahụ bụ izere izipu ihe mkpofu n'ebe a na-ekpofu ahịhịa, ebe a na-ere ọkụ, oké osimiri, ma ọ bụ akụkụ ọ bụla ọzọ nke gburugburu ebe obibi. Ka ọ dị ugbu a, ọ bụ naanị 9% nke plastik zuru ụwa ọnụ ka a na-emegharị. N'ime usoro ihe mkpofu efu, a ga-eji ihe mee ihe ndị ọzọga ba ụrụ ruo mgbe a ga-enweta ọkwa kachasị mma. samples.title: Jewish Neo-Aramaic dialect of Dohok
samples.excerpt:
Asụsụ Neo-Aramaic nke Ndị Juu nke Dohok bụ asụsụ Judeo-Aramaic nke sitere na obodo ndị Juu dị na Duhok, Kurdistan nke Iraq. Ndị Juu si Izrel pụọ na Iraq na-asụkwa ya n'afọ 1950.


== Akụkọ ihe mere eme ==

== Ihe ndị e ji mara ya ==
Judeo-Dohoki Aramaic nwere ọtụtụ ihe pụrụ iche nke na-eme ka ọ dị iche na asụsụ ndị ọzọ dị n'ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Neo-Aramaic nke gụnyere: Inwe ụdị ọdịdị-ọdịdị-ụdị, ịsọ mpi na-agafe agafe, na ịkewapụta okwu omume na nke kwụ otu ebe.
